summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for post-procedural monitoring and pain management following a flexible bronchoscopy with balloon dilation of the trachea and left main stem bronchus due to recurrent airway stenosis from relapsing polychondritis and Ruvalcaba-Myhre-Smith syndrome. The procedure successfully dilated the airways and removed obstructive pseudomembrane and granulation tissue. He experienced moderate chest pain managed with oxycodone and reported epigastric pain attributed to pirfenidone, which was addressed by increasing famotidine to twice daily. His white blood cell count rose post-procedure but was deemed reactive. He remained stable, with mild atelectasis on chest X-ray resolving clinically. He was discharged home with a short course of prednisone, instructions to continue all home medications, and follow-up planned with pulmonology.
problems: Long term (current) use of systemic steroids
Elevated white blood cell count, unspecified
